items.title: Focused Omni-Modal GUI Agents

items.title: Sage-A1.5: From Long-Horizon Execution to Scientific Exploration with Capability Composition
items.summary: In this report, we introduce Sage-A1.5, a 35B Mixture-of-Experts agentic model that builds on A1 to advance long-horizon problem solving through adaptive capability composition. Compared with A1, Sage-A1.5 learns not only to solve individual tasks, but also to organize work and revise its approach during execution. items.summary: Reliable multi-view forecasting requires videos from different cameras to describe the same evolving 3D scene. items.summary: Game engines and coding agents can specify the layout, motion, and camera of a scene, yet turning such coarse structure into realistic video requires a renderer that follows the structure and completes the appearance it leaves open. items.summary: Flow-matching vision-language-action (VLA) models generate an action chunk by iteratively denoising Gaussian noise, but typically execute only a short prefix before replanning with updated observations. items.title: SWIFT: Self-guided Weak-to-strong dIFfusion models via Target extrapolation
items.summary: Training high-quality diffusion models is computationally expensive, and inference-time guidance often adds further sampling cost. items.summary: World models enable embodied agents to anticipate action consequences, yet jointly modeling locomotion and manipulation across diverse embodiments remains challenging due to heterogeneous action spaces and limited multimodal supervision. items.summary: Enterprise agents answer questions over workplace records that evolve through team collaboration. items.summary: Generalizing real-time physics-based animation across diverse 3D shapes and spatial discretizations remains challenging. items.summary: Model--harness co-evolution has emerged as a prominent paradigm for recursive self-improving (RSI) agents, jointly evolving their execution scaffolds and intrinsic capabilities. items.summary: Image editing models produce impressive results for individual edits, but their quality often deteriorates over multiple editing turns. items.summary: Video face swapping transfers the reference identity to a target video while preserving its other attributes and motion. items.summary: Recent works show that LLMs can generate kernels with strong performance on server GPUs. items.title: StopLoss: Teaching Agents to Predict Failure and Stop Early
items.summary: Coding agents keep working on runs that will fail verification, and asking a frontier model to watch for this is expensive in its own right. items.summary: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) enables large language models (LLMs) to learn from privileged information (PI) without a separate teacher model. items.title: CyberArena: Benchmarking AI Agents in Live Symmetric Attack-and-Defense Combat
items.summary: AI agents are demonstrating increasingly strong offensive and defensive cybersecurity capabilities in the real world. items.summary: Recent advances in self-improving LLM agents have demonstrated the potential of AI systems that drive their own intelligence. items.summary: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly capable of acting in complex tool-use environments, yet they often fail to recognize when tasks are infeasible and no valid solution exists. items.summary: One of the first steps of a research pipeline is generating ideas.
